name: Comet's wayfaring odyssey
storyline:
Welcome to Nebulon Delta, a simulated environment that mimics the look of an alien planet and serves as a training ground for ambitious pups. You are Comet, outfitted in a rugged mecha suit and ready to follow Dr. Barnaby’s instructions.

Follow your instincts and get swept up in a fun game of “Fetch!”, developing new abilities along the way that will let you solve a series of ever-changing challenges.

Greet (or avoid) the Nebulites, the simulator’s eccentric stone inhabitants. They always enjoy good company.

Don’t forget to bring your hard hat. The journey isn’t always easy, especially when you’re walking along paths lined with giant trees bearing enormous (very ripe!) fruit. Luckily, you’ve had much worse concussions before.
summary: Born from a graduating students' capstone project featured on the 2025 BAFTA Student Awards Longlist and the Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2025, discover an adorable and zany physics-based puzzle adventure following a dog training to become a stellar superstar.
